description: MonkeyMode core guardrail profile: secrets and personal paths in tracked text files, for every engine. Matches run on raw text (string literals are not blanked). Changing this file needs user approval (docs/ai/12_GUARDRAILS_INSTEAD_OF_COMMENTS.md).

rules.message: A private key is in a tracked file. Remove it, revoke and reissue the key, and load it at runtime from a git-ignored file or a secret store. See docs/ai/07_ASSET_AND_DATA_POLICY.md
An AWS access key ID is in a tracked file. Revoke it and read credentials from the environment or a git-ignored config. See docs/ai/07_ASSET_AND_DATA_POLICY.md
A GitHub token is in a tracked file. Revoke it and use the environment or a credential helper instead.
A Slack token is in a tracked file. Revoke it and load it from the environment.
An API key (sk-... form) is in a tracked file. Revoke it and load it from the environment or a git-ignored .env file.

A credential-looking value is assigned in a tracked file. Move it to a git-ignored file (.env, *.local) or a secret store and read it at runtime. If it is a placeholder, write it in <angle-bracket> form.

An absolute path into someone's home folder is in a tracked file. It leaks a user name and breaks on other machines. Use a path relative to the project root, an environment variable, or a <placeholder>.
